title: South Korea's AI Chip Boom Raises Concerns Over Structural Economic Over-Dependence
detail: South Korea's booming AI chip sector is generating significant economic growth but also raising concerns about structural over-dependence and economic vulnerability. Analysts warn that heavy concentration in semiconductor exports—driven by surging AI demand—leaves the economy exposed to demand shocks, geopolitical supply chain disruptions, and technology shifts that could undercut the country's growth trajectory.
